name: What is the process for single window replacement with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for single window replacement with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we assess your needs and the existing window. We then provide a detailed estimate and help you select the best window for your home. Once your window is ordered, we schedule the installation at your convenience. On installation day, our team will carefully remove the old window, prepare the opening, install the new window, ensure proper sealing and insulation, and clean up the work area thoroughly. We then conduct a final walkthrough with you.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, estimate, window selection, ordering, installation, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
